SourceThing.ut_universal_tool.name: Universal Tool
SourceThing.ut_universal_tool.detail: A versatile workbench crafted at the workbench.
SourceThing.ut_universal_essence.name: Universal Essence
SourceThing.ut_universal_essence.detail: A condensed essence of universal power.
SourceThing.ut_condenser.name: Condenser
SourceThing.ut_condenser.detail: A device that extracts universal essence from materials.
SourceThing.ut_portable_workbench.name: Portable Workbench
SourceThing.ut_portable_workbench.detail: A portable workbench that opens five workbenches anywhere.
SourceThing.ut_tool_workbench.name: Tool Workbench
SourceThing.ut_axe_pickaxe.name: Mattock
SourceThing.ut_axe_pickaxe.detail: A multi-purpose tool combining axe and pickaxe. Performance depends on material.
SourceThing.ut_skill_trainer.name: Skill Trainer
SourceThing.ut_skill_trainer.detail: A training device that consumes crystals to level up skills of allies and pets.
SourceThing.ut_amplifier.name: Amplifier
SourceThing.ut_amplifier.detail: A device that consumes specified items to grant temporary buffs.
SourceThing.ut_portable_shipping.name: Portable Shipping Chest
SourceThing.ut_portable_shipping.detail: A portable shipping chest connected to the big shipping chest.
SourceThing.ut_duplicator.name: Duplicator
SourceThing.ut_duplicator.detail: A device that duplicates items by consuming universal essence.
SourceThing.ut_universal_factory.name: Universal Factory
SourceThing.ut_universal_factory.detail: A factory workbench that serves as the crafting hub of the universal series.
SourceThing.ut_decomposer.name: Universal Decomposer
SourceThing.ut_decomposer.detail: A device that decomposes materials into universal essence.
SourceThing.ut_essence_battery.name: Essence Battery
SourceThing.ut_essence_battery.detail: A battery that supplies 200W of electricity when placed.
SourceThing.ut_attribute_infuser.name: Attribute Infuser
SourceThing.ut_attribute_infuser.detail: A device that permanently enhances attributes by consuming universal essence.
SourceThing.ut_repairer.name: Universal Repairer
SourceThing.ut_repairer.detail: A device that removes curses and identifies equipment using universal essence.
SourceThing.ut_auto_factory.name: Auto Factory
SourceThing.ut_auto_factory.detail: A workbench for crafting automation devices.
SourceThing.ut_universal_generator.name: Universal Generator
SourceThing.ut_universal_generator.detai: A workbench that generates basic materials such as water and universal fertilizer.
SourceThing.ut_fertilizer.name: Universal Fertilizer
SourceThing.ut_fertilizer.detail: Instantly ripens a crop to its highest-yield harvestable stage when placed on it.
SourceThing.ut_catalyst.name: Universal Catalyst
SourceThing.ut_catalyst.detail: A catalyst crystal that powers the auto condenser, auto duplicator, and auto generator.
SourceThing.ut_amulet.name: Universal Amulet
SourceThing.ut_amulet.detail: Prevents the holder's death once by consuming 100 catalysts and 1000 essences.
SourceThing.ut_auto_duplicator.name: Auto Duplicator
SourceThing.ut_auto_duplicator.detail: Consumes one catalyst per hour while on, then duplicates crystals or ingots from an adjacent input unit in input order every 10 minutes: 5 to 10, using 20 electricity.
SourceThing.ut_auto_generator.name: Auto Generator
SourceThing.ut_auto_generator.detail: Has no internal storage. Directly processes catalysts or fertilizer from an adjacent input unit every 10 minutes and continuously consumes 1000 electricity.
SourceThing.ut_auto_condenser.name: Auto Condenser
SourceThing.ut_auto_condenser.detail: Consumes one catalyst per hour while on; processes crystals from an adjacent input unit every 10 minutes and sends essence to an output unit, using 20 electricity.
SourceThing.ut_mineral_generator.name: Mineral Generator
SourceThing.ut_mineral_generator.detail: Stores a vanilla ore as a template and spends 100 universal essence from an adjacent input feeder to generate one matching ore every 10 minutes.
SourceThing.ut_auto_smelter.name: Auto Smelter
SourceThing.ut_auto_smelter.detail: Consumes one catalyst per hour while on; processes up to 10 items every 10 minutes in input order with vanilla smelter recipes, using 20 electricity.
SourceThing.ut_input.name: Input Feeder
SourceThing.ut_input.detail: A container that feeds materials to adjacent auto devices.
SourceThing.ut_output.name: Output Feeder
SourceThing.ut_output.detail: A container that receives products from adjacent auto devices.
SourceThing.ut_collector.name: Item Collector
SourceThing.ut_collector.detail: Automatically collects nearby dropped items into its own 36-slot container.
SourceThing.ut_industrial_water.name: Industrial Water
SourceThing.ut_industrial_water.detail: Industrial water with the same material and drinking properties as vanilla water.
SourceThing.ut_fluid_extractor.name: Fluid Extractor
SourceThing.ut_fluid_extractor.detail: Produces industrial water every hour beside a water tile, with a 1.5x bonus when another extractor is within 3x3.
SourceThing.ut_auto_farming.name: Auto Farming Machine
SourceThing.ut_auto_farming.detail: Plants stored seeds row by row within the selected radius and waters newly planted tiles with industrial water.
SourceThing.ut_pipe_input.name: Input Terminal
SourceThing.ut_pipe_input.detail: Sends item stacks automatically to outputs on the same channel.
SourceThing.ut_pipe_output.name: Output Terminal
SourceThing.ut_pipe_output.detail: Receives items from inputs on the same channel.
